messages:
rachel: quick report - SDK vs REST parity issue on the `jobs/trigger` endpoint. REST treats missing `notify` as "ignore", Python SDK is sending `notify: null` and the service treats null as "true" -> users get unexpected emails. Repro below.
ben: yikes. minimal curl that behaves ok: \n```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' https://api.redwood.ai/jobs/trigger -d '{"job_id":"j-1","payload":{}}'
```
-> no notify emails.

rachel: Python SDK (v1.8.0) sampleapp call: \n```py
client.jobs.trigger("j-1", payload={})
# observed raw body: {"job_id":"j-1","payload":{},"notify": null}
```
-> server interprets null as explicit true due to legacy decoder.
oli: probable codegen/serializer bug: optional bool defaulting to None then included in JSON. Short fix: strip None keys before encoding. Long fix: change generator to mark body optionals as omitted if unset.
qa-bot: test failure T-9450 added.
ben: short-term patch: update Python client serializer to drop None, release 1.8.1, and add an e2e that diffs SDK vs curl payloads for job endpoints. Also update sampleapp snippets to pass notify=False explicitly when desired.
devex: agree. Add RED-3566 to track generator change, client hotfix, sampleapp updates, and a CI parity job.
rachel: thanks team — tagging @eng-runtime. Will open PR with test and changelog entry now.
